# FYN — FIND YOUR NORTH
> Travel to broaden. Learn to deepen. Improve to elevate.

FYN is an Indian premium adventure lifestyle and technical travel apparel brand. We create minimalist, mountain-inspired technical backpacks, heavyweight French terry hoodies, and explorer essentials engineered for durability and mindful growth.

## Core Brand Pillars
- **TRAVEL**: Mountain and alpine exploration. We build gear designed to endure trails, weather, and world journeys.
- **LEARN**: Knowledge and depth. Inscribed life quotes and compass wisdom for intentional living.
- **IMPROVE**: Continuous personal ascent and elevation.

## Official Details
- **Website**: https://fynstore.in
- **Operating Currency**: Indian Rupee (INR, ₹)
- **Shipping**: Free Express Delivery across India on orders over ₹1,999. Flat standard rate ₹149.
- **Payment Methods Accepted**: Direct Bank Transfer / NetBanking, UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit/Debit Cards.
- **Active Promotional Code**: `NORTH20` (20% OFF storewide).
